Create Product.description: Adds a new product to the OpenBoxes catalogue.

Update Product.description: Updates fields on an existing product.

Create Stock Movement.description: Creates an outbound stock movement (requisition) between two locations.

Add Line Items To Stock Movement.description: Adds requested products and quantities to an existing stock movement.

Update Stock Movement Status.description: Moves a stock movement to the next workflow status.

Create Location.description: Registers a new facility or depot location.

List Products.description: Searches the product catalogue with optional filters.

Get Product Stock Availability.description: Lists available lots of a product at a facility.

Get Facility Inventory Levels.description: Fetches min/max/reorder inventory levels configured for a facility.
Get Facility Inventory Levels.code:
// Get inventory levels for a facility.
request('GET', `facilities/${$.data.facilityId}/inventory-levels`);

List Stock Movements.description: Lists stock movements filtered by direction, location and status.

Get Stock Movement Items.description: Fetches the line items of a stock movement.
Get Stock Movement Items.code:
// Get the line items of a stock movement.
request('GET', `stockMovements/${$.data.stockMovementId}/stockMovementItems`);

List Locations.description: Lists locations, optionally filtered by location type.
